sayLines.line: Filled 1L (clean — Haven well). 3L carried (3kg). (-10 kcal hauling, 1 tick.) Cistern: 19L left.
A woman, maybe 30s looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)

Travel 1 tile to meadow.
— Open ground —
Wind moves through the grass in waves. Seeds catch on your clothes, hitching a ride.
Movement — a brown rabbit, white tail flashing.
👁 Skittish — it bolts at a shadow. Come in slow, or run it down.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.

Travel 2 tiles to trail edge.
— An old trail —
Something walked here regularly, before. The path remembers even if no one does.
Movement — a thick-bodied rattlesnake, chevron bands, the tail a blur of dry sound.
👁 It warns first — the rattle IS the negotiation. Heed it. Pin it behind the head with a forked stick, or take it at range. Never reach.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.

Travel 2 tiles to trail edge.
— An old trail —
Scat on the trail, still soft. You study it longer than is dignified and learn exactly one thing: walk louder.
Movement — an armadillo rooting in the leaf litter, armor clanking.
👁 It doesn't run — the armor IS the plan. It'll hunch down and dare you. The armor turns a blow; grab the soft underbelly, or trap the grub trail at night.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.
📖 LEARNED: Old World Caches (Level 1). You know where people hid things: under floorboards, in hollow trees, behind loose bricks.
You've learned Old World Caches — it carries Eagle Eye.

Travel 2 tiles to grove.
— Nut trees —
Hickories and oaks, heavy with mast. This is a pantry that grows.
Movement — a waddling porcupine, quills rattling softly.
👁 Never grab it barehanded. A bow works clean; hands get quills. Flip it with a long stick if you must.
Unfamiliar unknown berries — into the bag. (Unknowns lump together; sort them at camp.)
You also take some vine (crafting material).
Journal: Mast country. The old trees feed everything.
The System notes the synergy — foraged a plant new to this ground: +1 field XP.
📓 Journal: you UNDERSTAND Green Thumb, Literally. It resonates with: something unnamed, something unnamed.
A shot in the dark — you take what's green: 4× unknown berries. Into the bag, unnamed. (Not food until identified — sort them at camp.) This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
Travel 1 tile to Haven.
You keep a day's food (1400 kcal) — nothing extra for the pantry this time.
1 unprocessed haul onto the counter — the clock is ticking.
Someone by the fire nods at the counter. "We pool food here. Keep what you need for the road — the rest feeds everyone, once it's food."
Nobody at the fire knows your haul any better than you do. It'll be your own hands that teach you.
You walk back into Haven. 3 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
A woman, maybe 30s heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." The pantry won't fill itself.
A woman, maybe 50s, with sun-creased eyes heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." The pantry won't fill itself.
A person, maybe 50s heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." The pantry won't fill itself.
A woman, maybe 50s, with a limp heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
A woman, maybe 50s, with restless hands heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." The pantry won't fill itself.
A man, maybe 40s, with a nervous tic heads out to forage. "Bringing dinner back. One way or another." Good kit is the difference out there.
A man, maybe 60s sets out to find A person, maybe 50s. "Won't be long." Company makes the road shorter.
A woman, maybe 50s, with calloused knuckles heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek sets out to find A woman, maybe 50s, with a limp. "Won't be long." Company makes the road shorter.
📖 the woman in her 60s is walking the person in their 40s through an evergreen tree with big veined leaves and clusters of yellow-orange fruit — leaf, stem, smell, the beginner's tour.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
A woman, maybe 30s shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
📋 A woman, maybe 50s, with sun-creased eyes wants to know what's by the creek. "Just look. Come back and tell me."

You catch A man, maybe 60s telling the fire about A woman, maybe 60s. "the woman in her 60s showed the person in their 40s an evergreen tree with big veined leaves and clusters of yellow-orange fruit" The story's already growing.
📖 A woman, maybe 60s has their finds spread out on a cloth, re-tying the bundle tighter.
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
A woman, maybe 30s shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 50s, with a limp telling A woman, maybe 50s, with restless hands about A woman, maybe 30s. The retelling is already better than the event.
💧 A woman, maybe 50s, with sun-creased eyes returns with water: +3 clean.
Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

🛡️ A woman, maybe 50s, with sun-creased eyes catches you eyeing the bark plates — claw-scored, vine-laced. "...Want to actually SEE one?" They talk you through it — wide strips dried flat, laced overlapping like shingles, snug but not tight. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
